business_scope.primary_industry_name: C-Suite Executive Search and Specialist Tech Headhunting

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Indigenous Customary Law)

Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (New York 1958)
UN Convention on Transparency in Treaty-based Investor-State Arbitration (Mauritius Convention, signed 2015)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended); Companies and Trust Service Providers Act [Cap 270]; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 14 of 2022 (repealing the Anti-Money Laundering Act 2000); Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organised Crime Act [Cap 292]; United Nations (Financial Prohibitions, Arms Embargoes and Travel Ban) Act [Cap 293]; Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act [Cap 190]; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit directives and VFSC Guidance Notes on AML/CFT

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder, director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport issuing authority of the document's origin country; notarization by a licensed Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional bank reference letter evidencing good standing and source of funds for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank in the UBO's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent corporate registry extract for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed Registered Agent engagement letter, AML/CFT KYC questionnaire, and UBO declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (prepared internally; no external legalization required)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: None – internal compliance document retained by Registered Agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-engagement screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, signatories and UBOs against the United Nations Consolidated Sanctions List, Vanuatu FIU financial prohibitions alerts, and commercial PEP databases (World-Check or equivalent); OFAC SDN screening is applied as a prudent institutional overlay even though OFAC is not itself a Vanuatu statute; Enhanced Due Diligence is mandatory where a UBO is a PEP, a family member or close associate of a PEP, or a resident of a FATF-identified high-risk jurisdiction; adverse media and source-of-funds verification are completed before any incorporation filing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Office portal and VFSC-licensed Registered Agents' e-filing gateway (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The International Company name must be in Roman/Latin script; Bislama, English or French words are all accepted; the name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated' or an approved abbreviation; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing or reserved name in the VFSC Companies Register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may re-submit the same name with substantive variation to remove similarity or file a formal administrative appeal with the VFSC Companies Office within 14 calendar days, attaching the VFSC name search certificate and a written explanation distinguishing the proposed name from conflicting entries; the VFSC Registrar issues a written determination, and the decision is subject to judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted. Section 8 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] requires a physical registered office in Vanuatu maintained at the premises of a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; a PO Box or purely virtual address is insufficient for an International Company engaged in executive search and headhunting.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate; estimated risk of unannounced VFSC physical inspection for a standard headhunting International Company is less than 15% per year absent adverse sanctions, PEP or AML triggers; VFSC conducts risk-based inspections primarily on licensed Registered Agents, but all client corporate files must be immediately available at the agent's physical office.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap. 222 (Vanuatu) as amended, ss. 3, 8, 11, 18, and 25
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-2) and executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for an International Company; share capital is set in the Articles of Association, and no escrow or paid-up capital deposit is required for ordinary share capital
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED. WHEREAS the subscriber has executed the Articles of Association; WHEREAS the registered agent and initial directors have been nominated. RESOLVED: 1. That the share subscription by the founding shareholder be ratified and the subscribed shares be allotted as set out in the Register of Members. 2. That the registered office at the address of the registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, be adopted as the statutory registered office under the International Companies Act. 3. That the appointed directors and company secretary be confirmed to hold office until otherwise determined by ordinary resolution. 4. That all fees and professional expenses incurred in connection with incorporation be approved and paid. DATED this ___ day of ______.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Companies Registry (VFSC online portal or physical counter at Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application via the VFSC e-services portal or written form, indicating the proposed company name including the suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. The registry will screen for conflict with existing names, prohibited words, and similarity to international protected names. A non-refundable reservation fee is payable by bank transfer, card, or cash at the cashier counter.
required_dossiers: Identification of founding shareholder (certified passport copy)
Proof of payment of reservation fee
Letter of authorization from the proposed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or flagged, the applicant may file an amended reservation with an alternative name within 5 business days. If unclear conflict, request a written notice and submit a caveat or consent letter from the prior holder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the executed Form IC-2, Memorandum and Articles of Association, and registered agent appointment documents to the VFSC Companies Registry. The documents must be notarized and, if executed abroad, apostilled or legalized per the Hague Apostille Convention unless the signatory appears before a Vanuatu notary. The Registry verifies the statutory details and confirms the registered office address.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber
Consent of the registered agent in Vanuatu
Consent forms of proposed directors and secretary
Passport copies and proof of address for each director/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent will receive an official query noting deficiencies. The applicant has 14 days to file a corrective supplemental statement; otherwise, the application is deemed abandoned. No penalty applies if corrected within the prescribed period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory verification, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company's registration number, date of incorporation, and authentication under the official seal. The certificate is delivered to the registered agent physically or electronically.
required_dossiers: Payment receipt for corporate registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If incorporation is refused or further information is requested, the applicant may submit a formal representation to the VFSC Legal and Enforcement Division within 30 days. For simple correction of informational defects, a resubmission of the Form IC-2 with stamped amendments is accepted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Creation of Statutory Registers and Share Certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent on behalf of the Company / VFSC post-incorporation filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the certificate is issued, the registered agent prepares the statutory registers, including Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Secretary, and Register of Charges. Share certificates are printed, sealed, and delivered to the shareholder. An initial annual return and beneficial ownership confirmation are filed electronically with the VFSC if required.
required_dossiers: List of directors, secretary, and shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For missing or defective filings, the registered agent submits a rectification filing to the VFSC; late fees may apply after 30 days. A revised register may be tabled at the first board meeting for ratification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Licensing Division (for International Companies); Ministry of Finance – Business Licensing Office (for any domestic business activities)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Trade License / Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 190] (Professional Services – Employment and Recruitment)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category 4 administrative office activity; no full EIA or Environmental Impact Statement required for a registered-office-based executive search and headhunting operation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to a zero-emission office-based commercial activity. If local operational offices are opened, general municipal waste disposal standards under the Waste Management Act apply; no industrial wastewater or VOC thresholds are triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance from the Vanuatu Fire Service (Port Vila) for office premises; Structural building inspection report from the Public Works Department confirming minimum load capacity and evacuation route compliance; Occupational Health and Safety clearance for office workplace environment under the Occupational Health and Safety Act [Cap. 185].

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official portal: https://www.vrca.gov.vu. Company and International Company (IC) registry functions are administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 - Incorporate the Vanuatu International Company through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, a registered office in Port Vila, and, where the IC will hold any local physical presence or employ staff, secure the applicable VIBO business license for executive-search services. Step 2 - If the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu or its taxable turnover (including zero-rated export retainers) exceeds VT 5,000,000 in any consecutive 12-month period, apply to VRCA on the prescribed form for a VAT registration number, attaching the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office certificate, business license (if applicable) and details of the resident registered agent; registration must be applied for within 21 days after the end of the month in which the threshold is exceeded. Step 3 - Voluntary VAT registration is available, but input VAT recovery is restricted where output consists exclusively of zero-rated offshore executive-search services. Step 4 - If the IC employs personnel physically working in Vanuatu, register separately with VRCA for PAYE withholding before the first payroll run. Step 5 - Obtain a written tax-status confirmation letter from VRCA confirming the IC exempt status and the zero-rating of offshore headhunting supplies; no income-tax TIN is issued because Vanuatu imposes no corporate, capital gains, withholding or personal income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No domestic check-the-box, pass-through, or hybrid-mismatch election exists because Vanuatu levies no income tax at either entity or shareholder level; the exemption applicable to an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] applies automatically. Foreign owners remain subject to home-jurisdiction classification (e.g., U.S. IRC Section 7701 check-the-box and CFC/GILTI rules may classify the IC and impute its income). Domestically, an IC may elect to re-domicile as an ordinary company under the Companies Act, thereby surrendering IC exempt status, and may reverse that election with VFSC consent; the pre-1992 exempt-company category was consolidated into the International Company regime. Separately, an IC may elect the monthly VAT filing cycle to accelerate refunds on its zero-rated export service lines.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 36 of 1997 [Cap. 245], administered by VRCA; import excise duties under the Customs Act and fuel/tobacco/alcohol excise regimes are administered separately by Vanuatu Customs
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (five million vatu) of taxable turnover in any 12-month period; zero-rated export supplies count as taxable turnover for threshold purposes, so a headhunting IC whose offshore retainers and success fees exceed VT 5,000,000 must register for VAT even though all output is zero-rated, principally to reclaim input VAT on local overhead; the threshold is measured on a rolling 12-month basis and registration is mandatory within 21 days after the end of the month in which the threshold is exceeded
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government-authorization API, digital stamping or QR-code invoice mandate is in force for VAT as at the relevant stage. Taxpayers issue standard paper or PDF tax invoices containing the seller name, VAT registration number, sequential invoice number, date, description, VAT-exclusive amount, VAT rate and VAT amount. VAT returns are filed electronically through the VRCA e-services portal on a monthly or quarterly cycle, with monthly filing phased in for larger taxpayers. ASYCUDA World is used only for customs declarations of physical goods. VAT invoices and underlying export documentation must be retained for at least 7 years for audit and input-credit substantiation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Schedule 2 of the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 245], a supply is zero-rated when it is (a) an export of goods, (b) a supply of services to a non-resident recipient who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and whose place of business or fixed establishment receiving the service is outside Vanuatu, or (c) a supply of services directly related to international transport. For the executive-search and headhunting scope: the retainer contract must be executed with the foreign employer; the C-suite or specialist candidate placement must be for a position located outside Vanuatu; the VAT-exclusive retainer and success-fee invoices must be issued to the offshore client and marked 'Zero-rated - export of services'; and the IC must not be supplying local recruitment or human-resources placement services to a Vanuatu taxable person (such domestic supplies attract 15% VAT). Pure offshore headhunting retainers and placement success fees satisfy zero-ratng because the service is consumed at the employer's establishment outside Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (ASYCUDA SAD filing) capturing shipment details where physical goods form part of the transaction
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing the movement of goods out of Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of hard-currency export proceeds in Vanuatu
Signed executive-search retainer agreement and engagement letter identifying the non-resident employer and the jurisdiction in which the services are consumed
Commercial tax invoice marked 'Zero-rated - export of services' carrying the client's registered business address
Evidence of client non-residence (foreign certificate of incorporation, overseas utility bill, or foreign tax ID) and evidence that the placed position is located outside Vanuatu
SWIFT MT103 or Wise B2B wire confirmation matching the invoiced retainer or success fee
Placement report and candidate acceptance note evidencing that the executive's employment is with a non-resident employer outside Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating and VAT-refund claims are verified through desk audits, bank-record cross-checks and field examinations. If VRCA disallows zero-rating because documentation is missing or inconsistent (e.g., no inward remittance within 180 days, backdated contract, or evidence that the actual beneficiary is a Vanuatu resident), the supply is re-characterized as taxable at 15%, the net VAT is assessed on the gross retainer, associated input VAT is clawed back, and statutory penalty tax plus interest is imposed. Fraudulent or careless export zero-rating claims attract civil penalties of up to 100% of the tax understated (up to 200% for repeat offenders), and willful evasion carries criminal fines up to VT 500,000 and/or imprisonment up to 2 years under the Value Added Tax Act, with directors personally liable under 'knowingly concerned' provisions. VRCA may reopen assessments within the statutory limitation period, without time limit where fraud is demonstrated, and refunds are withheld until the substantiation bundle is fully delivered.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125]; the RBV is the statutory regulator for money, banking, foreign exchange control and the Vatu (VUV) currency, with the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 64] administered jointly by the RBV and the Ministry of Finance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The VUV is convertible on a partially controlled basis. Current account transactions are freely permitted through authorised dealers, while capital account transactions by residents require RBV exchange control approval. A Vanuatu International Company (VU_IC) is statutorily treated as a non-resident entity under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], and enjoys a ministerial exchange control exemption; consequently the entity may hold and settle entirely in foreign currency (USD/EUR/AUD) with no VUV conversion burden and no profit repatriation blocking. Dividends and branch remittances from the IC are tax-exempt in Vanuatu and outflow is unrestricted subject only to bank-level anti-money-laundering verification of the beneficiary.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporters, Exchange Control Notices issued by the RBV require export receipts to be remitted to Vanuatu through an authorised dealer within 180 days of shipment or invoice maturity, and the VUV equivalent must be offered for sale if the exporter has VUV obligations. The VU_IC is not a resident exporter: ISIC 7830 executive search services are intangible cross-border service exports settled directly into offshore foreign-currency accounts of the IC, and mandatory VUV surrender does not apply. If the IC ever receives a payment in VUV from a Vanuatu resident (prohibited under the IC regime), conversion to foreign currency would require RBV concurrence and is deemed an exceptional licensed act.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency account (USD/AUD/VUV) + segregated fee escrow sub-account
Operational foreign-currency account (USD) + settlement clearing account
Operational corporate account (EUR/USD) for European client retainer flows
Capital escrow account (VUV only; not recommended for offshore IC)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Moderate. No Vanuatu-licensed electronic money institution (EMI) exists, and the Wise B2B rail is not legally operable for a Vanuatu-incorporated IC because Wise does not accept VU corporate registrations and cannot settle VUV. A foreign EMIs (e.g., UK FCA-authorised Wise/Currencycloud) may be used only as an upstream collection point funded by overseas clients, provided the EMI does not carry on unlicensed payment business in Vanuatu; the chain must end in a settlement account held at a Vanuatu authorised dealer or a reputable offshore bank to satisfy the RBV definition of deposit-taking.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is practically permitted for a VU_IC via its VFSC-licensed registered agent acting as introducer, provided at least one director completes a live video interview witnessed by a notary or consular officer. Domestic Tier-1 banks in Vanuatu generally require the signatory director to appear physically at the branch if a video baseline cannot be established; a full physical meeting is waived for low-risk ISIC 7830 entities when the beneficial owner is a tax-resident individual of a FATF-member jurisdiction and the registered agent supplies a certified corporate register extract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident International Company with no economic presence in the Pacific region
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified IC certificate, memorandum and articles, VFSC good standing, registered office certificate, registered agent introduction letter, service agreement with a Vanuatu-based agent, and a written substance narrative demonstrating that revenue is generated solely from non-resident executive-search fees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner tax residence or passport in a high-risk or grey-listed jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised passport, recent utility bill, independent banking reference from the owner's home bank, source-of-wealth statement for initial funding, and proof of professional qualification in executive search (retained search licence or association membership).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Predicted cross-border retainer payments from multiple low-transparency private clients (e.g., private family offices)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed executive-search engagement agreements, invoice schedules and recruitment mandates naming the hiring client, client corporate registration extract, and three-way AML declaration confirming funds are corporate-generated and not personal cash proceeds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No VUV activity and no physical office in Vanuatu triggering shell-risk instincts in bank compliance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax exemption certificate from the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance, registered agent lease agreement, director and shareholder register, board resolution designating accounts, up-to-date payroll of overseas employees, and the IC's foreign-currency only operating policy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial share capital and working-capital injection route via SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's personal or holding-company account, using field 59 beneficiary as the VU_IC, field 50 ordering party exactly matching the registry shareholding, and field 70 remarks stating 'INITIAL CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - IC NO. [VFSC number]'. Accompanying remittance must include: IC incorporation certificate, shareholder resolution on capital advance, and bank-source statement. RBV pre-approval is not required for the IC exemption; authorised dealers apply only standard KYC and will reject if the transfer purpose is ambiguous.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Client retainer refunds and debiased candidate-selection fee refunds settle via SWIFT MT103 from the BSP or ANZ foreign-currency operating account, with purpose code 'VIRT' equivalents (management/consultancy fee) in field 70. For complex cross-border settlements with selected clients preferring instrument-based trade finance, an MT700 documentary letter of credit is acceptable but generally disproportionate for ISIC 7830; standby letters of credit (SBLC) can be used to secure retainer commitments. Payments to contractors and affiliate researchers use the same MT103 flat-file or bank-hosted API; no VUV conversion or RBV approval is required given the IC's non-resident foreign-currency status.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/VUV forward contracts with an RBV-authorized dealer for receipts converted to VUV for any permitted local invoice
AUD/VUV and NZD/VUV onshore deliverable forwards for expense hedging on Vanuatu registered-agent fees
USD/EUR and USD/AUD cross-currency swaps executed through an authorised dealer bank for outstanding retainer receivables
Plain-vanilla FX options (calls and puts) written by a licensed authorised dealer for protect-only structures; NDFs and speculative derivatives are not permissible in the VUV market

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return and annual government fee payment (International Companies Act, s.95; International Companies (Fees) Act)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 2 months after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; anniversary-based filing, not aligned to the calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts a penalty of VT 3,000 (approx. USD 25) plus a 10% late-payment surcharge on the annual fee; continued non-compliance beyond 3 months exposes the company to VFSC default notices and administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register, followed by dissolution after a further statutory notice period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Certificate and beneficial ownership (UBO) reconfirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed VFSC-registered agent; UBO particulars held at the registered office and reportable to VFSC upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Co-terminous with the annual return deadline (within 2 months after the incorporation anniversary); UBO updates must be lodged with the registered agent promptly upon any shareholding or control change and in all cases before the next annual reconfirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The registered agent must report a defaulting company to VFSC; failure to reconfirm UBO data suspends the company's good standing, prevents issuance of certificates of incumbency and good standing, and blocks share transfers and corporate banking transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Vanuatu Business Licence renewal status confirmation (Business Licence Act) — exemption confirmation for non-resident International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue / relevant Municipal Council
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal by 31 December if a licence is required; International Companies deriving no income from within Vanuatu and maintaining no physical office remain outside the licensing net and require only a written exemption confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not applicable where the IC holds no physical office and earns no Vanuatu-source income; operating without a required licence exposes the company and its directors to statutory fines and daily default penalties under the Business Licence Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None — Vanuatu International Companies are exempt from mandatory statutory audit irrespective of turnover, asset value, or shareholding; an audit arises only when required by the company's articles, ordered by a members' resolution, or directed by VFSC for regulatory cause.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act requires only internal accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and disclose the financial position with reasonable accuracy; no IFRS, Vanuatu GAAP, or filed financial statements are statutorily mandated for International Companies; IFRS is typically adopted if a voluntary certified audit is commissioned.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under VFSC beneficial-ownership transparency rules applicable to International Companies, the company must maintain a current schedule of ultimate beneficial owners through its licensed registered agent; the annual return cycle includes a written reconfirmation of UBO identity and percentage control, and the registered agent must be notified promptly of every share transfer or change of control so the register remains accurate; VFSC may require submission of the UBO schedule as part of annual return verification.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (board and shareholder minutes and resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 650–1,500 per year (licensed Vanuatu registered agent service, including registered office, nominee secretarial support, and annual return filing support)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–3,500 per engagement where a voluntary certified audit is commissioned; not a statutory annual cost for a Vanuatu International Company

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Vanuatu corporate income tax for a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. No branch profit tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax and no dividend, interest or royalty withholding tax. VAT is not chargeable on exported executive-search services. The recurring State costs are VFSC annual filing fees, governmental fees and registered-agent service fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu does not impose a corporate income tax return. The only statutory annual filing is the VFSC International Company Annual Return, submitted through the VFSC Electronic Filing Portal or by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation or as otherwise directed by the registered agent; the deadline is not tied to a financial year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and International Company number of the VU IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as shown on the certificate of incorporation; no tax identification number is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu and full details of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; the registered agent's physical Vanuatu address must be stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, corporate secretary, and any alternate officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide foreign residential or registered addresses of all appointed directors; nominee appointments must be disclosed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders, share classes, nominal capital and ultimate beneficial ownership declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose non-resident individual or corporate shareholders; the registered agent must hold current CDD/UBO records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of no Vanuatu-source business or no business with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident executive-search companies must confirm they do not invoice, employ or transact with Vanuatu residents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance notification and AML/CFT compliance acknowledgement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Register any relevant activity; for standalone offshore headhunting, declare no Vanuatu substance requirement unless the ESR test is triggered.
The licensed registered agent must sign electronically; no foreign notarisation is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts VFSC administrative late fees and reinstatement costs. Continued default may result in a monetary penalty against the company and each director, administrative strike-off, loss of the International Company status and disqualification of directors from acting as officers of any VFSC-regulated entity.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and maintains only Tax Information Exchange Agreements. DTA relief is functionally not applicable because the domestic withholding tax rate on dividends is already zero. For dividend distributions to a shareholder in a high-tax jurisdiction, the shareholder must apply the foreign tax credit rules of that jurisdiction; the VU IC should provide a board resolution, registered agents' records, dividend declaration, bank transfer record and maintenance of financial statements to support the transaction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on outbound royalties and debt interest under Vanuatu law. No treaty reduction is required. IP-licensing and intra-group financing structures should nevertheless be arm's-length in substance to avoid characterisation as a sham by foreign tax authorities.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0 - not applicable. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax and has no mandatory Local File or Master File legislation. Non-resident shareholders must maintain transfer-pricing and substance documentation required by their home jurisdiction, particularly CFC and anti-abuse rules.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu applies Economic Substance Regulations through the VFSC under the Economic Substance Implementation legislation. A VU International Company must file an economic substance notification and, if undertaking a relevant activity, demonstrate adequate physical presence, employees, expenditure and management and control in Vanuatu. Executive search and headhunting are not automatically specified relevant activities unless the company operates as a group service centre or headquarters. A standalone offshore headhunting agency billing foreign clients should still maintain board minutes, client contracts, staff records and expense evidence to rebut any shell-company or sham characterisation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company to conceal economic ownership or profits from executive-search services, or failing to declare the entity and income in the shareholder's country of tax residence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself has no income tax offence, but the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may investigate, strike off the IC and exchange information under the TIEA. The investor's home tax authority may impose tax evasion penalties, interest, confiscation orders and criminal fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and ultimate shareholders may be subject to civil restitution, asset-tracing orders, travel restrictions and imprisonment under the applicable foreign tax fraud legislation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining only a registered agent and a mailing address while claiming tax-exempt status, with no real decision-making, client-facing operations or economic substance in any jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC cancellation of International Company status, monetary administrative penalties, disqualification of directors and mandatory strike-off under the economic substance regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for penalties, barred from acting as directors of any VFSC-regulated company, and ordered to make full civil restitution of assets stripped through the shell structure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Violations by the Executive Search Agency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving client retainer payments through Wire or Wise without conducting customer due diligence, beneficial ownership checks, source-of-funds verification or suspicious transaction reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC AML/CFT enforcement action, monetary penalties, license suspension or revocation, freezing of bank accounts and referral to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the designated compliance officer may face civil penalties, confiscation orders, travel bans and imprisonment for money laundering or failure to report suspicious transactions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Providing executive-search services to Vanuatu-resident clients, maintaining a physical recruitment office in Vanuatu, or engaging in employment agency activities without the required Vanuatu business licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Stop orders, denial of business licence, monetary penalties and revocation of the VU IC's right to operate; the company may lose the statutory limited-liability shield.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and authorised officers may be jointly and severally liable for contracts entered into while unlicensed and may be subject to criminal fines or imprisonment for carrying on a regulated business without lawful authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Filings and Misrepresentation to VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false annual return, concealing the ultimate beneficial owner, or making a false declaration of no Vanuatu-source business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under the International Companies Act and AML/CFT laws, administrative strike-off, monetary penalties and permanent disqualification of directors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will normally be pierced; directors and signatories are personally liable for civil restitution, travel bans, immigration-listing and imprisonment for the period prescribed by the applicable Vanuatu criminal statute.
